text:
anna_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC asking for concrete logging/audit artifacts for their vendor risk review (SIG/CAIQ). They want: admin activity audit trail, SIEM ingest sample, retention policy text, and a redacted export they can drop into their VRM. Can we assemble a deliverable?

sam_solutions: We can. Suggested package: 1) redacted CloudTrail export (last 30 days) 2) app admin-audit sample (JSON) 3) retention-policy excerpt (pdf) 4) SIEM mapping doc (ECS) + short README on how we forward logs. Need security approval for sharing exports.

jess_engineering: I have a small script that pulls CloudTrail for a timeframe and uploads to a temporary S3 bucket. Example we use for internal demos:
```bash
# export last 30 days and gzip
START=$(date -d '30 days ago' +%Y-%m-%d)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time $START --max-results 50 --output json > cloudtrail-30d.json
gzip cloudtrail-30d.json
aws s3 cp cloudtrail-30d.json.gz s3://redwood-share/acme-poc/ --acl private
```
I can run with redaction enabled (strip IPs, usernames) before upload.

mike_security: We need to be explicit about redaction and metadata we keep. For VRM we typically provide: eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.type, requestParameters (redacted), sourceIPAddress (obfuscated), awsRegion, eventSource. No PII. Also include a signed statement that data is redacted and ephemeral.

lina_product: Acme asked whether logs include admin role changes, token usage, and service account actions. Confirm those are captured?

sam_solutions: Yes — admin role changes and token creation/deletion are in the audit stream and CloudTrail. Our application-level admin events (team invitations, role grants) are in a separate admin log — we can include a 7-14 day sample of that in JSON lines format.

anna_sales: Good. What about SIEM-ready format? They want to ingest into Splunk/QRadar for mapping.

jess_engineering: We can provide two flavors: raw cloudtrail JSON + a flattened ECS-mapped JSON. Example mapping snippet for one event: 
```json
{
  "@timestamp": "2026-03-15T12:34:56Z",
  "event.action": "ConsoleLogin",
  "user.name": "redacted_user",
  "source.ip": "10.0.x.x",
  "cloud.provider": "aws",
  "aws.region": "us-west-2"
}
```
That should be ingestable. We'll include a small mapping table in the README.

mike_security: Also include proof of forwarding: a one-week sample from our Kinesis Firehose -> S3 -> SIEM pipeline and a screenshot of the delivery status from the console (sanitized). That demonstrates end-to-end.

anna_sales: Timeline? Acme wants artifacts by EOD Fri. Is that realistic?

sam_solutions: If security signs off today, engineering can produce redacted exports + mapping doc by tomorrow EOD. Need legal to OK sharing the sample export (we redact, but policy requires sign-off).

mike_security: I'll review the scripts and add the redaction rules. Also need to confirm retention windows we state. Current policy: production logs retained 90 days in hot storage, archived for 365 days encrypted at rest. We can provide the policy excerpt (pdf) and a short statement: retention varies by log type.

lina_product: Can we include a short paragraph that describes admin audit scope (what actions are logged) so the VRM reviewer doesn't ask follow-ups?

sam_solutions: Yes — I'll draft a one-pager: list of admin events, log schema, retention, forwarding, and redaction notes.

anna_sales: Any blockers?

mike_security: Legal approval and redaction checklist. Also need confirmation from infra whether we can create a transient S3 bucket in their region (they requested EU-only for compliance).

jess_engineering: We can create an eu-west-1 bucket for export and share a presigned URL (7-day expiry). That meets data locality ask. Will need a jira to provision and an ops rotation to run the export.

anna_sales: OK. Action items: @mike_security review/redact scripts (today), @jess_engineering run export in eu-west-1 (tomorrow), @sam_solutions assemble deliverable and draft one-pager (tomorrow), @lina_product prepare VRM-friendly summary (tomorrow). I'll coordinate legal ping.

sec-bot: Export job queued: export-job-1189 started by jess_engineering for acme-poc (eu-west-1).

lina_product: One more — Acme asked if we can provide a signed attestation of controls (sections of SIG/CAIQ) that are relevant to logging/monitoring. That's a separate artifact but low effort if security approves.

mike_security: We have a logging controls attestation template — can fill and sign. Add to deliverables.

anna_sales: Perfect. I'll update AcmeCR with the plan and EOD Friday ETA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
